statement: The reviewed xpadneo implementation provides Linux input, force feedback, optional mouse/keyboard/consumer devices and battery power-supply handling, but does not register a headset PCM sound device or an independent LED-class output. Its own documentation says controller audio is unavailable over Bluetooth. This limits xpadneo as a consumer benchmark and does not independently prove a hardware-wide audio or lighting impossibility.
